children.name: Evidence
children.value: The 2 SBR headers and 38 SBR payloads have the layout FAAC 2.x writes: headers that send bs_header_extra_1 and not bs_header_extra_2, with start frequency 15, crossover band 0, no noise bands and stop frequency 11, repeated every 30 access units, and data that codes every envelope and noise floor across frequency, with no coupling, sinusoids or extended data

children.value: highest coded band ends at about 12000 Hz (max_sfb 47)

findings.message: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 38 of 38 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 48000 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 24000 Hz.
